# Number to Nepali words

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/nepali-words/

Write an integer amount in Nepali words using lakh and crore grouping. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Convert 125000 to Nepali digits and words, with an optional rupee-and-paisa amount.

## Limits and checks

Use the displayed numeric limits and proofread financial documents. The converter does not validate the legal requirements of cheques or official forms.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [Nepali number-word vocabulary — MIT source with common-spelling normalization](https://github.com/kushal1o1/nepali-num2word)
